differences.rationale: Review-first: help channels closed for the first 60 active s (spec §4.1, D01).
Requests move from active 40/150/240 to 80/180/270 so none falls in the locked review (spec §4.1, D01 proposal).
Majority request seat drawn by a fair coin instead of JT always asking twice (invariant 7 balance, D07).
Derived by coin_majority_shuffle rather than a fixed JT/PM/JT multiset.
Reference demo_structured_delay_length -> concurrent; identical schedule because the body is chosen before timing (spec §6.5).
Reference demo_structured_delay_length -> concurrent; same schedule, no generation step.
Additive (wait starts after the model answers) -> concurrent (generation overlaps the wait) (spec §6.3, §6.5).
Demo display floor -> concurrent; floor delay(2,4) becomes the concurrent delay component, so eligible = max(grant + delay, ready) is unchanged in shape.
Floor distribution moves into the delay component (was fixed 0 under the floor mechanism).
Neutral fallback bank without busy/distracted cues or unsolicited solicitations (spec §7.3, INV-0705, D07).
Historical 'a little distracted' social prompt not used (spec §7.3).
Deterministic neutral social replies proposed until D07 selects a generation mode.
